speaker_1_voice.tooltip: Reference audio for 'Speaker 1' or '[1]' in the script.

speaker_2_voice.tooltip: Reference audio for 'Speaker 2' or '[2]' in the script.

speaker_3_voice.tooltip: Reference audio for 'Speaker 3' or '[3]' in the script.

speaker_4_voice.tooltip: Reference audio for 'Speaker 4' or '[4]' in the script.

attention_mode.tooltip: Attention implementation: Eager (safest), SDPA (balanced), Flash Attention 2 (fastest), Sage (quantized)

cfg_scale.tooltip: Classifier-Free Guidance scale. Higher values increase adherence to the voice prompt but may reduce naturalness. Recommended: 1.3

do_sample.tooltip: Enable to use sampling methods (like temperature and top_p) for more varied output. Disable for deterministic (greedy) decoding.

force_offload.tooltip: Force model to be offloaded from VRAM after generation. Useful to free up memory between generations but may slow down subsequent runs.

inference_steps.tooltip: Number of diffusion steps for audio generation. More steps can improve quality but take longer. Recommended: 10

model_name.tooltip: Select the VibeVoice model to use. Official models will be downloaded automatically.

quantize_llm_4bit.tooltip: Quantize the Qwen2.5 LLM to 4-bit NF4 via bitsandbytes. Diffusion head stays BF16/FP32.

seed.tooltip: Seed for reproducibility. Set to 0 for a random seed on each run.

temperature.tooltip: Controls randomness. Higher values make the output more random and creative, while lower values make it more focused and deterministic. Active only if 'do_sample' is enabled.

text.default:
[1] Hello, this is a cloned voice.
[2] And this is a generated voice, how cool is that?
text.tooltip: The script for generation. Use '[1]' or 'Speaker 1:' for speakers. If a speaker in the script lacks a reference voice, it will be generated via zero-shot TTS.

top_k.tooltip: Top-K sampling. Restricts sampling to the K most likely next tokens. Set to 0 to disable. Active only if 'do_sample' is enabled.

top_p.tooltip: Nucleus sampling (Top-P). The model samples from the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds this value. Active only if 'do_sample' is enabled.
